officerCard.title: Centurion
officerCard.intro: A standing officer for this project: he holds the charge, watches jobs and fleet, dispatches workers from his kit, and pages you only when something genuinely needs you. You talk to him in a conference; his background log is the session transcript. The post outlives him — kit, budgets, and memory stay with it between incarnations.
officerCard.readOnly: You can view this Officer Post, but only a project owner or system administrator can manage it.

backlog.on: on — ready tickets are dispatched into free pool slots
backlog.off: off — pools stay idle until he dispatches by hand
backlog.releaseClosed: enable transition held by deployment release policy
backlog.stalledDetail: {{count}} claimed ticket(s) not moving beyond {{threshold}} h ({{source}}) — these are never released automatically; resume or cancel the job, then close or re-ready the ticket.

brain.actionsHint: Hard cap on tool calls each wake.
brain.modelHint: The brain his judgment runs on — pick a strong one; his wakes are cheap but his decisions steer everything. Blank uses your session default.
brain.reasoningHint: Effort per wake. Clamped to what the model supports.

budgets.tokenCeilingHint: Across his whole command. Blank means no ceiling.
budgets.workerSpendCeilingHint: Optional across every auto-pulled pool. Blank means no mechanical spend brake.

autoPull.label: Fill categorized pools automatically
autoPull.releaseClosed: Enabling is unavailable until this deployment's unattended-operation gates are complete. Off and all spend ceilings remain editable.
autoPull.confirmation: Enabling starts unattended worker dispatch and spend from ready project tickets at the next tick. Confirm only after reviewing the roster, categories, and spend ceilings.

category.none: No pool — officer dispatches by hand

decommission.hint: His kit, budgets, and sitrep fingerprints stay on the post; recommissioning restores them with a continuity brief.
decommission.inFlightWarning: He has {{count}} job(s) in flight. Decommissioning leaves them running — their completions land on the post's ledger for his successor.

hold.noteHint: Shown on the badge — why he is standing down. Legate input still reaches him while held.

messages.commissionedWithBrief: Commissioned — his first wake carries the continuity brief. Open log to watch him take the post.
messages.decommissioned: Post decommissioned — kit, budgets, and fingerprints stay on the post for his successor.
messages.held: Held — dispatches pause and the watchdog stands down; your input still reaches him.
messages.released: Released — queued events drain within a tick.
messages.recycleStarted: Runtime recycle started — the maintenance hold remains until the replacement is healthy.
messages.updated: Post updated — the next sitrep's capacity line carries the truth.

phase.awaiting-old-pod-exit: waiting for the old runtime to drain

policy.title: Worker questions
policy.label: When a worker asks a question
policy.hint: Officer first falls back to you if the officer is unavailable, and escalates to you if he stays silent past {{minutes}} min.
policy.hintVacant: Officer first falls back to you if the officer is unavailable, and escalates to you if he stays silent past {{minutes}} min. While the post is vacant, questions come direct to you regardless.

roster.countHint: Zero blocks new admission without cancelling work already in flight; counts may range from 0 to 20.
roster.hint: Give a slot a pool and the officer fills it automatically from ready tickets of that kind; leave it unset for capacity he dispatches by hand.
roster.maxWorkersHint: Flat concurrency cap. Without a kit it is the only gate (default 3).
roster.spendCeilingHint: Optional ceiling for this pool; blank means no pool-specific brake.

sleep.hint: He files his own sleep between wakes; the server clamps to these bounds.

vacant.flatCapHint: No slots means a flat cap of 3 concurrent workers. The officer runs headless; his first wake carries the continuity brief — and the while-vacant ledger, if jobs finished without him.
vacant.hint: The post is vacant — no centurion holds this century. A project owner or system administrator can assign the kit and commission him.
